claim:
For the equal-mass Majumdar–Papapetrou dihole on the symmetry plane \(z=0\), in units where the half-separation is \(1\), let \(M_*=\sqrt{27/8}\), \(\rho_*=\sqrt{5}\), \(\delta=M-M_*>0\), \(\rho_0=\rho_*+\sqrt{\delta}X\), \(\Phi(X)=aX-bX^3\), \(a=128\sqrt{30}/703125\), \(b=8\sqrt{5}/140625\), and \(c=\sqrt{a/(3b)}=\sqrt{16\sqrt{6}/15}\). For each fixed \(X>c\) or \(X<-2c\), the equatorial scattering deflection angle obeys
\[
\lim_{\delta\downarrow0}\delta^{1/4}\bigl[\hat\alpha(\rho_0;M)+\pi\bigr]
=\frac{8}{125}\int_X^\infty\frac{dY}{\sqrt{\Phi(X)-\Phi(Y)}}.
\]
integrity: The constants are derived analytically from the explicit effective potential.
The asymptotic tail control is stated separately from the local Taylor expansion.
No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the static equal-mass Majumdar–Papapetrou dihole on the reflection-symmetry plane.
The limit is for M=M_*+delta with delta tending to zero from above and fixed X>c or X<-2c.
No higher-order correction or finite-source image calculation is claimed.
title: Uniform photon-ring merger crossover in the Majumdar–Papapetrou dihole
